description: Full name field storing personal names with 30 unique values and no missing data (0 nulls). Contains diverse cultural naming conventions including Malay patronymics (Bin/Binte), Indian patronymics (s/o, d/o), and Chinese names. recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Standardise deterministic case deviations to Title Case using the dominant convention: 'lim wei jie' → 'Lim Wei Jie', 'WANG SHI JIE' → 'Wang Shi Jie'.
